CANONICAL_NAME.value: SimpleKalmanFilter -- a compact scalar Kalman filter (Denys Sene)

VERSION.value: github.com/denyssene/SimpleKalmanFilter master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: Kalman filter (1960, Rudolf Kalman): recursive least-squares estimation of hidden state from noisy measurements via predict/update; this is a minimal scalar C++ reference for embedded sensor smoothing

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: optimal recursive estimation of hidden state under noise

value.built_to: recover a hidden true value from a stream of noisy measurements by recursively combining a prediction with each new observation, weighted by their uncertainties
value.pressure: measurement noise and the impossibility of observing the true state directly; a naive average lags, a raw reading is jittery
value.success_means: an estimate that tracks the true state with error variance far below the raw measurement noise

value.failure_condition: a mistuned filter either lags reality (over-smooths) or passes the noise through (under-smooths); a navigation estimate drifts and the vehicle mislocates

ANCESTRY.value: Kalman filter (1960, Rudolf Kalman): recursive least-squares estimation of hidden state from noisy measurements via predict/update; this is a minimal scalar C++ reference for embedded sensor smoothing
